user_goal: Learn transferable decision-making in beautiful professional Chinese lettering, not regenerate an attractive text image then trace in Figma.
prior_state: R1..R9 geom/vector-only negative; R10/R11 valid image provenance but mostly body-font same-stroke corrections unlike expressive artwork.

case1.author: 梁志坚（字体设计师）
case1.original_article_description: Author personally narrates reference study, scaffold, crude and revision, eight alternative 喜 designs and final selected lettering, including exact edit strategies.
source_content_points: No copied original reference characters in target; extract shared visual features, and ensure actual glyph recognition.
Per-character ink mass and style traits must agree across four-character phrase, not fit a universal stroke ratio.
Author redesigns 喜 due to seven horizontal marks and highly dense 口 modules: breaks top crossbar, expands counters, selectively deletes bottom crossbars, combines dots/horizontal into a new gesture.
Such deletions are constrained by legibility and word-level coherence, not applied universally.

images.phase: feature study extracted from different text, not final asset
stepwise frame animation from source author

case2.author: 张家佳（Behance published project）
case2.original_article_description: Author-published sequential diagrams comparing gridded original Chinese characters, loose artistic stroke sketches, full calligraphic logotype and refinement.
case2.design_mechanism: Sparse 上 and dense 座 cannot be forced into same standard glyph frame; wordmark composition, hybrid stroke flow and forms are designed jointly.

images.phase: same creator explains rebalancing disparate character complexity
same two-letter glyph stroke sketch and topology correction
hand-drawn simplified strokes vs finished sculpted brush-like shapes

protocol.source_validation: Download exact fixed URLs and decode original bytes; store only sha256/dimensions/mime/derived aggregate metrics; do not copy images into public repo or GitHub artifacts
protocol.source_gate: At least 3 chronologically staged source images of same 梁志坚 work from original article verified; at least 1 independently authored Behance stage photo verified
protocol.semantically_confirmed: Only after checking actual stage image contents, not from filenames or article captions alone
protocol.conflict_of_interest: Self-reported author design explanation supports within-sample rationale but not aesthetic gains of our model.
protocol.next: Select one confirmed explicit whole-stroke topology/composition decision, draft exact new-glyph applicability conditions and anti-application countercases, then design one genuinely new glyph with equal-budget baseline and human review.
